# Project Guidelines

## Code Style
- Use semantic HTML5 elements for structure
- Follow consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Write clean, readable CSS with comments for sections

## Architecture
- Single-page website structure
- main.html as the main entry point
- main.css for all styles

## Build and Test
- No build tools required; open main.html directly in a web browser
- Test manually by viewing in different browsers

## Conventions
- File naming: lowercase with hyphens (e.g., main.html, contact-us.html)
- CSS classes: use descriptive names, avoid abbreviations
- Keep the project simple and vanilla HTML/CSS without frameworks unless necessary
